desc:
🐉 Welcome to Fly A Dragon! ☁️

How to Play:
🪂 Jump off the cliff and dive through the air to capture a dragon
⚡ Boost your stamina in the wind tunnel to battle stronger dragons
🗺️ Climb through 10 sky zones, from grassy meadows to the Cosmic Rift
🐲 Collect over 1,000 unique dragons of all shapes, sizes, and colors
💎 From Common to Eternal: Discover giant Mega Dragons and glowing Rainbow Mutations
🏰 Expand your base and let your dragons earn money, both online and offline
🥚 Fuse 3 matching dragons to create a bigger one and take on stronger challenges
🔮 Some hidden dragons are extremely rare, so keep your eyes peeled!

📱 Playable on PC, Mobile, Tablet, and Console!
